question: How must a foreign educational credential be assessed?

claims.text: A foreign educational credential must be assessed by a designated organization or institution to establish its Canadian equivalency.
claims.quote: submit their completed foreign educational credential and the equivalency assessment (educational credential assessment [ECA] report) issued by a [designated organization or institution](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/corporate/partners-service-providers/foreign-educational-credential-assessment.html)

basis: Evaluated document 4f0d8388867b622426e1959578b5f9d7.pdf submitted under upload slot educational_credential_assessment.
prose: To receive points for foreign education in Express Entry, applicants must provide an Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) report from a designated organization or institution.
